scope: Observed CLIENT UI calculation and resource metadata. No server RNG, online probability, availability, or exploitation claim. n is literally instance byte +0xA9 plus one; interpretation as next enchant stage is supported by enchant UI context, not live validation.
formula_for_n_1_to_20: raw = clamp(clamp(trunc0(k[q]*(stoneLevel-equipmentLevel+10)/(1 if n<=10 else 2)), 0, 800 if n<=10 else 500) + supplementRaw, 0, 1000); displayPercent = raw * float32(0.1)
